test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: How many items did the Swaran Singh Committee recommend to be incorporated in the Constitution of India as duties of the Indian citizen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Swaran Singh Committee recommended the incorporation of **8 duties** for Indian citizens in the Constitution of India.
 
• These recommendations led to the addition of Part IVA to the Constitution, which enumerates the Fundamental Duties of citizens.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are intended to serve as a constant reminder to citizens that while enjoying their rights, they should also be conscious of their duties towards the nation.
 
• The duties include respecting the Constitution, the national flag, and the national anthem, cherishing the noble ideals of the freedom struggle, and upholding the sovereignty and integrity of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
 
• The concept of Fundamental Duties is inspired by the Constitution of the erstwhile Soviet Union.
 
• Initially, ten Fundamental Duties were listed, but the 86th Amendment Act, 2002 added an eleventh duty, making it obligatory for parents to provide education to their children aged between 6 and 14 years.
 
• These duties are non-justiciable, meaning they are not enforceable by the courts for their violation.
 
• The inclusion of Fundamental Duties aims to promote a sense of discipline and commitment among citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**The Swaran Singh Committee suggested eight items to be incorporated in the constitution as duties of the citizen. These are mentioned below:

 
• To respect and abide by the constitution and the laws.
 
• To uphold the sovereignty of the nation and to function in such a way as to sustain and strengthen its unity and integrity.
 
• To respect the democratic institutions enshrined in the constitution, and not to do anything which may impair their dignity or authority.
 
• To defend the country and to render national service including military service when called upon to do so.
 
• To abjure communalism in any form.
 
• To render assistance and cooperation to the State in the implementation of Directive Principles of State Policy, and to promote the common good of the people so as to sub serve the interests of social and economic justice.
 
• To abjure violence; to protect and safeguard public property and not to do anything which may cause damage or destruction to such property.
 
• To pay taxes according to the law.

However, then Congress government led by Prime Minister Indira Gandhi did not accept all suggestions or recommendations made by the Swaran Singh Committee.
